card.name: Just before a dose amount
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces right before a dose amount or added drug, such as 'addition of', 'dose of', 'at least' or a space before a number of mg. Seen in dosing and administration text.

modes.label: Linking word before a drug
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'with' just before a named drug being added or combined.
modes.example: required addition<< of>> mycophenolic acid to high

modes.label: Gap before a number
modes.description: The space just before a numeric dose in mg.

modes.label: Quantity wording
modes.description: Words like 'at least' that lead into a dose amount.
modes.example: at<< least>> 60 mg of oral morphine

card.plain: It fires on the small word or space just before a drug name or dose amount is given.
